package e2e

// 路由与接管：预加载完成前不接请求（原 2R 草稿，改为经 Found 建状态、不再直接写所有权集合）、kill -9 时在途请求的
// 答复与同 RequestID 收敛、登记 TTL 过期与同 sid 拉起后的重新登记、alliance.transfer 之后调用方缓存改投、
// stop_founding + transfer + 停进程的缩容三步、建盟被拒留下的空认领在重启后答确定的“不存在”。

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/errcode"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/servicerpc"

	rpcalliance "example.com/planet/internal/rpc/alliance"
)

// foundMany 并发建 n 个联盟（发起者 leaderBase+1..），返回联盟 ID 与耗时。
func (s *suite) foundMany(client *rpcalliance.BusClient, n int, leaderBase int64, workers int) ([]int64, time.Duration) {
	start := time.Now()
	ids := make([]int64, n)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	next := make(chan int)
	errs := make(chan error, workers)
	for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for i := range next {
				leader := leaderBase + int64(i) + 1
				var reply rpcalliance.Reply
				// 单次期限给足 20s：机器负载高时 Found 排队，免得超时重发再排一遍队。
				var err error
				for attempt := 0; attempt < 5; attempt++ {
					ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(s.ctx, 20*time.Second)
					reply, err = client.Found(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("found-%d", leader), leader, 1000, fmt.Sprintf("e2e-%d", leader), true)
					cancel()
					if err == nil || servicerpc.Classify(err) == servicerpc.OutcomeRejected {
						break
					}
				}
				if err != nil {
					errs <- fmt.Errorf("found %d: %w", leader, err)
					return
				}
				ids[i] = reply.Alliance.AllianceID
			}
		}()
	}
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		select {
		case next <- i:
		case err := <-errs:
			close(next)
			wg.Wait()
			s.t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	close(next)
	wg.Wait()
	select {
	case err := <-errs:
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	default:
	}
	return ids, time.Since(start)
}

type logLine struct {
	Time   string `json:"time"`
	Msg    string `json:"msg"`
	Mod    string `json:"mod"`
	Loaded int    `json:"loaded"`
	Failed int    `json:"failed"`
	Listed int    `json:"listed"`
	Empty  int    `json:"empty"`
}

// preloadWindow 从进程日志（JSON 行）里取最后一次起服的预加载开始 / 完成与 owner Mod 开始的时刻。
func preloadWindow(t *testing.T, path string) (start, done, owner time.Time, report logLine) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	parse := func(s string) time.Time {
		v, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, s)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("log time %q: %v", s, err)
		}
		return v
	}
	for _, text := range strings.Split(string(raw), "\n") {
		var line logLine
		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(text), &line) != nil {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case line.Msg == "mod start (service-specific)" && line.Mod == "remote_entity.preload":
			start, done, owner = parse(line.Time), time.Time{}, time.Time{}
		case strings.HasPrefix(line.Msg, "remote_entity preload mod: preloaded owned entities"):
			done, report = parse(line.Time), line
		case line.Msg == "mod start (service-specific)" && line.Mod == string(rpcalliance.CapabilityName):
			owner = parse(line.Time)
		}
	}
	return start, done, owner, report
}

// TestAllianceE2EPreloadOrder：生成工程的 alliance 进程（真实 bootstrap、owner Mod、预加载 Mod）在起服预加载完成之前
// 不在总线上接路由 RPC。状态经 Found 造：单实例建 ALLIANCE_E2E_PRELOAD（缺省 500）个联盟，正常停机，再同 sid 拉起；
// 客户端从进程启动起每 5ms 发一次 Result（route），记下每次是 no responders 还是答复。同时记下预加载时间与常驻内存
// （方案 §2.7 / KNOWN-LIMITS ⑥ 要的随实体数增长）。
func TestAllianceE2EPreloadOrder(t *testing.T) {
	s := newSuite(t, 15*time.Minute)
	count := 500
	if raw := os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_PRELOAD"); raw != "" {
		count, _ = strconv.Atoi(raw)
	}
	a := s.start("alliance-3000", "alliance", 3000, procOptions{})
	rssEmpty := rssMB(a)
	ids, took := s.foundMany(s.client(nil, 20*time.Second), count, 100_000, 16)
	t.Logf("founded %d alliances in %v (%.0f/s); rss %.0f MiB before, %.0f MiB after", count, took.Round(time.Millisecond), float64(count)/took.Seconds(), rssEmpty, rssMB(a))
	s.stop(a, syscall.SIGINT)

	first := target(t, ids[0])
	probe := s.client(fixedOwner(3000), 300*time.Millisecond)
	type attempt struct {
		at       time.Time
		answered bool
		err      error
	}
	var attempts []attempt
	launched := time.Now()
	s.launch(a)
	deadline := time.Now().Add(2 * time.Minute)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(s.ctx, 300*time.Millisecond)
		_, err := probe.Result(ctx, first, "probe")
		cancel()
		answered := servicerpc.Classify(err) == servicerpc.OutcomeOK || servicerpc.Classify(err) == servicerpc.OutcomeRejected
		attempts = append(attempts, attempt{time.Now(), answered, err})
		if answered {
			break
		}
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	last := attempts[len(attempts)-1]
	if !last.answered {
		t.Fatalf("alliance never answered after restart: %v", last.err)
	}
	s.waitReady(a, time.Minute)
	time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
	start, done, owner, report := preloadWindow(t, a.log)
	if start.IsZero() || done.IsZero() || owner.IsZero() {
		t.Fatalf("log lacks preload start %v / done %v / owner Mod start %v", start, done, owner)
	}
	if report.Loaded < count {
		t.Fatalf("the preload loaded %d of %d alliances (listed %d, failed %d)", report.Loaded, count, report.Listed, report.Failed)
	}
	if owner.Before(done) {
		t.Fatalf("the owner Mod started at %v, before the preload finished at %v", owner, done)
	}
	during := 0
	for _, a := range attempts {
		if a.answered && a.at.Before(done) {
			t.Fatalf("a route request was answered at %v, before the preload finished at %v: %v", a.at, done, a.err)
		}
		if !a.answered && a.at.After(start) && a.at.Before(done) {
			during++
		}
	}
	if during == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no request landed inside the preload window %v..%v; raise ALLIANCE_E2E_PRELOAD", start, done)
	}
	if value := s.routeValue(first); !strings.HasPrefix(value, "3000:") {
		t.Fatalf("after the preload the registration of %d is %q", first, value)
	}
	t.Logf("PRELOAD n=%d listed=%d loaded=%d failed=%d preload=%v start→ready=%v rss_after_preload=%.0fMiB; %d requests during the preload got no responders; first answer +%v after it",
		count, report.Listed, report.Loaded, report.Failed, done.Sub(start).Round(time.Millisecond), time.Since(launched).Round(time.Millisecond), rssMB(a), during, last.at.Sub(done).Round(time.Millisecond))
}

type joinOutcome struct {
	player, alliance int64
	request          string
	first            servicerpc.Outcome
	err              error
}

// TestAllianceE2ECrashTakeoverAndScaleIn：两个实例。① kill -9 时在途的入会请求答“可重试”或“结果未知”，同 RequestID
// 查 Result、重发后得到确定结果，每个玩家恰好入会一次；② kill -9 后登记仍在、请求可重试，TTL 过期后登记消失、仍可重试；
// 同 sid 拉起后预加载重新登记（值不变）；③ alliance.transfer 迁走一个联盟，带旧缓存的调用方经改投到新 owner；固定答
// 旧 owner 的调用方同样改投；④ 缩容三步：stop_founding → transfer 到持有数为 0 → 停进程，联盟由另一实例接着答、成员不丢。
func TestAllianceE2ECrashTakeoverAndScaleIn(t *testing.T) {
	s := newSuite(t, 15*time.Minute)
	a := s.start("alliance-3000", "alliance", 3000, procOptions{})
	b := s.start("alliance-3001", "alliance", 3001, procOptions{})
	client := s.client(nil, 3*time.Second)
	leader := int64(200_000)
	onB := s.foundOn(client, 3001, 8, &leader)
	onA := s.foundOn(client, 3000, 2, &leader)

	// ① 在途请求：200 个玩家并发入会到 3001 上的联盟，发出约 400ms 后 kill -9 3001（同一联盟的入会在 owner 上按到达顺序逐个处理，约 75ms 一个，8 个联盟之间并行，此时大部分还在排队）。
	const players = 200
	outcomes := make([]joinOutcome, players)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	startGate := make(chan struct{})
	for i := 0; i < players; i++ {
		i := i
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			<-startGate
			o := joinOutcome{player: 300_000 + int64(i), alliance: onB[i%len(onB)]}
			o.request = fmt.Sprintf("join-%d", o.player)
			_, o.err = client.Join(s.ctx, o.request, o.player, 1000, target(t, o.alliance))
			o.first = servicerpc.Classify(o.err)
			outcomes[i] = o
		}()
	}
	close(startGate)
	time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
	s.stop(b, syscall.SIGKILL)
	killedAt := time.Now()
	wg.Wait()
	counts := map[servicerpc.Outcome]int{}
	for _, o := range outcomes {
		counts[o.first]++
		if o.first == servicerpc.OutcomeRejected {
			t.Fatalf("player %d: a join refused while its owner was killed: %v", o.player, o.err)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("KILL in-flight joins: ok=%d retryable=%d unknown=%d", counts[servicerpc.OutcomeOK], counts[servicerpc.OutcomeRetryable], counts[servicerpc.OutcomeUnknown])

	// ② kill -9 之后：登记仍指向 3001，请求可重试；TTL 过期后登记消失，请求仍可重试（所有权记录仍指向 3001）。
	tB := target(t, onB[0])
	before := s.routeValue(tB)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(before, "3001:") {
		t.Fatalf("right after kill -9 the registration of %d is %q, want still 3001", tB, before)
	}
	if _, err := s.client(nil, time.Second).Info(s.ctx, tB); servicerpc.Classify(err) != servicerpc.OutcomeRetryable {
		t.Fatalf("info on the killed owner: %v (%s), want retryable", err, servicerpc.Classify(err))
	}
	s.eventually("the killed instance's registrations expire", 60*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		return s.routeValue(tB) == "", s.routeValue(tB)
	})
	t.Logf("KILL registrations of 3001 expired %v after kill -9", time.Since(killedAt).Round(time.Second))
	if _, err := s.client(nil, time.Second).Info(s.ctx, tB); servicerpc.Classify(err) != servicerpc.OutcomeRetryable {
		t.Fatalf("info with the owner down and its registration expired: %v, want retryable", err)
	}

	// 同 sid 拉起：预加载重新登记，值（sid:代际）与崩溃前相同。
	restarted := time.Now()
	s.launch(b)
	s.waitReady(b, 2*time.Minute)
	if value := s.routeValue(tB); value != before {
		t.Fatalf("after restart the registration of %d is %q, want %q (same sid, same epoch)", tB, value, before)
	}
	t.Logf("KILL 3001 ready %v after restart, registration %q restored by the preload", time.Since(restarted).Round(time.Millisecond), before)

	// 在途请求收敛：先按原 RequestID 查 Result（确定执行没有），再重发得到确定答复；每个玩家恰好是成员一次。
	executed, notExecuted := 0, 0
	for _, o := range outcomes {
		if o.first == servicerpc.OutcomeOK {
			continue
		}
		var result rpcalliance.ResultReply
		err, _ := definite(s.ctx, time.Minute, func(ctx context.Context) error {
			var err error
			result, err = client.Result(ctx, target(t, o.alliance), o.request)
			return err
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("player %d: result of %s: %v", o.player, o.request, err)
		}
		if result.Found {
			executed++
		} else {
			notExecuted++
		}
		var reply rpcalliance.Reply
		err, _ = definite(s.ctx, time.Minute, func(ctx context.Context) error {
			var err error
			reply, err = client.Join(ctx, o.request, o.player, 1000, target(t, o.alliance))
			return err
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("player %d: resend %s: %v", o.player, o.request, err)
		}
		if result.Found && !reply.Replayed {
			t.Fatalf("player %d: Result said %s was executed, but the resend was not a replay", o.player, o.request)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("KILL unanswered joins after restart: executed before the crash=%d, not executed=%d; all resent to a definite answer", executed, notExecuted)
	for _, id := range onB {
		info, err := client.Info(s.ctx, target(t, id))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		in := members(info.Alliance)
		for _, o := range outcomes {
			if o.alliance == id && !in[o.player] {
				t.Fatalf("player %d is not a member of %d after its join converged", o.player, id)
			}
		}
		if len(info.Alliance.Members) != len(in) {
			t.Fatalf("alliance %d lists a member twice: %+v", id, info.Alliance.Members)
		}
	}
	for _, o := range outcomes {
		g, err := client.Guard(s.ctx, guard(t, o.player))
		if err != nil || g.State.AllianceID != o.alliance || g.State.PendingRequestID != "" {
			t.Fatalf("player %d guard %+v err %v, want alliance %d with nothing pending", o.player, g.State, err, o.alliance)
		}
	}

	// ③ 迁移后改投：cached 先把 onA[0] 的 owner（3000）缓存下来；在 3000 上 transfer 给 3001；cached 再调用经改投到 3001。
	cached := s.client(nil, 3*time.Second)
	tA := target(t, onA[0])
	if reply, err := cached.Info(s.ctx, tA); err != nil || reply.ServedBySID != 3000 {
		t.Fatalf("info before transfer: %+v %v", reply.ServedBySID, err)
	}
	moved := s.admin(a, "alliance.transfer", map[string]any{"ids": []int64{tA}, "to_sid": 3001})
	t.Logf("TRANSFER %v", moved)
	lookupsBefore := s.owners.reads.Load()
	reply, err := cached.Info(s.ctx, tA)
	if err != nil || reply.ServedBySID != 3001 {
		t.Fatalf("info through the cached route after transfer: served by %d err %v, want 3001", reply.ServedBySID, err)
	}
	if reply, err := s.client(fixedOwner(3000), 3*time.Second).Info(s.ctx, tA); err != nil || reply.ServedBySID != 3001 {
		t.Fatalf("info through a client that always names 3000: served by %d err %v, want 3001", reply.ServedBySID, err)
	}
	s.eventually("the new owner registers the moved alliance", 15*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		return strings.HasPrefix(s.routeValue(tA), "3001:"), s.routeValue(tA)
	})
	t.Logf("TRANSFER cached caller followed the redirect to 3001 (ownership reads during it: %d); registration now %q", s.owners.reads.Load()-lookupsBefore, s.routeValue(tA))

	// ④ 缩容三步：3001 退出 Found 队列组 → 把持有的全部转给 3000 → 停 3001。
	s.admin(b, "alliance.stop_founding", nil)
	for i := 0; i < 6; i++ {
		if reply := s.found(client, leader+int64(i)+1); reply.ServedBySID != 3000 {
			t.Fatalf("after stop_founding on 3001 a new alliance landed on %d", reply.ServedBySID)
		}
	}
	leader += 6
	var rounds []string
	s.eventually("3001 gives everything away", 2*time.Minute, func() (bool, string) {
		data := s.admin(b, "alliance.transfer", map[string]any{"count": 1000, "to_sid": 3000})
		rounds = append(rounds, fmt.Sprint(data))
		moved, _ := data["moved"].([]any)
		pending, _ := data["pending"].([]any)
		failed, _ := data["failed"].([]any)
		if len(failed) > 0 {
			t.Fatalf("transfer failed: %v", data)
		}
		return len(moved) == 0 && len(pending) == 0, fmt.Sprint(data)
	})
	t.Logf("SCALE-IN transfer rounds: %d", len(rounds))
	s.stop(b, syscall.SIGINT)
	all := append(append([]int64{}, onB...), onA...)
	for _, id := range all {
		info, err := s.client(nil, 3*time.Second).Info(s.ctx, target(t, id))
		if err != nil || info.ServedBySID != 3000 {
			t.Fatalf("alliance %d after scale-in: served by %d err %v", id, info.ServedBySID, err)
		}
	}
	for _, o := range outcomes {
		g, err := client.Guard(s.ctx, guard(t, o.player))
		if err != nil || g.ServedBySID != 3000 || g.State.AllianceID != o.alliance {
			t.Fatalf("guard %d after scale-in: %+v served by %d err %v", o.player, g.State, g.ServedBySID, err)
		}
	}
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(all))
	for _, id := range all {
		ids = append(ids, fmt.Sprint(id))
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)
	t.Logf("SCALE-IN 3001 stopped; alliances %s and %d guards answered by 3000", strings.Join(ids, ","), len(outcomes))
}

// TestAllianceE2ERejectedFoundingAfterRestart：建盟被拒（发起者已在联盟）时，发出的联盟号在写准入里被首写认领、事务回滚，
// 留下“所有权记录是本实例、权威里没有数据”的空认领。同 sid 重启后：预加载把它计为 empty（不算 failed、不记 ERROR、
// 不登记路由）；对它的 Info 答确定的“不存在”（框架的 entity_not_found；重启前内存里还有业务新建的空实例，答业务的
// 100031），而不是一直“可重试”（修前：remote.4）。重启后的宣战补发扫描把空认领读到的“不存在”当作没有待确认宣战、
// 走完全部联盟（2026-11-07 前每次扫描都在它上面失败、按退避重试，排在它后面的联盟永远扫不到）。
func TestAllianceE2ERejectedFoundingAfterRestart(t *testing.T) {
	s := newSuite(t, 10*time.Minute)
	a := s.start("alliance-3000", "alliance", 3000, procOptions{})
	client := s.client(nil, 5*time.Second)
	const leader = int64(400_001)
	founded := s.found(client, leader)
	again, err := client.Found(s.ctx, "found-again-400001", leader, 1000, "e2e-again", true)
	if servicerpc.Classify(err) != servicerpc.OutcomeRejected {
		t.Fatalf("a second founding by a member answered %+v %v, want a rejection", again, err)
	}
	next := s.found(client, leader+1)
	empty := next.Alliance.AllianceID - 1 // 一个实例、一个计数器：两次成功之间被拒的那次发的号
	if empty == founded.Alliance.AllianceID {
		t.Fatalf("no alliance id was minted for the refused founding (founded %d, next %d)", founded.Alliance.AllianceID, next.Alliance.AllianceID)
	}
	lease, claimed, err := s.owners.GetRemoteOwnership(s.ctx, target(t, empty))
	if err != nil || !claimed || lease.OwnerSid != 3000 {
		t.Fatalf("ownership of the refused alliance %d = %+v %v %v; the refused founding left no claim, so the case under test does not arise", empty, lease, claimed, err)
	}
	_, before := client.Info(s.ctx, target(t, empty))
	if servicerpc.Classify(before) != servicerpc.OutcomeRejected {
		t.Fatalf("info on the refused alliance before restart: %v (%s), want a definite rejection", before, servicerpc.Classify(before))
	}

	s.stop(a, syscall.SIGINT)
	relaunched := time.Now()
	s.launch(a)
	s.waitReady(a, 2*time.Minute)
	time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
	_, _, _, report := preloadWindow(t, a.log)
	if report.Failed != 0 || report.Empty < 1 || report.Loaded < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("preload after restart: listed=%d loaded=%d empty=%d failed=%d; want the empty claim counted as empty, nothing failed",
			report.Listed, report.Loaded, report.Empty, report.Failed)
	}
	if raw, err := os.ReadFile(a.log); err != nil || strings.Contains(string(raw), "preload failed") {
		t.Fatalf("the restarted instance logged a failed preload (read err %v):\n%s", err, tail(a.log, 20))
	}
	if value := s.routeValue(target(t, empty)); value != "" {
		t.Fatalf("the empty claim got a route registration %q", value)
	}
	s.eventually("the war scan after the restart goes through", 30*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		_, _, done := warScanLine(a.log, relaunched)
		return done, "no war scan line after the restart:\n" + tail(a.log, 5)
	})
	if raw, err := os.ReadFile(a.log); err != nil || strings.Contains(string(raw), "scan for wars waiting for their enemy failed") {
		t.Fatalf("the war scan failed on the empty claim (read err %v):\n%s", err, tail(a.log, 20))
	}
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
		_, after := client.Info(s.ctx, target(t, empty))
		if servicerpc.Classify(after) != servicerpc.OutcomeRejected || servicerpc.Code(after) != errcode.CodeEntityNotFound {
			t.Fatalf("info on the refused alliance after restart: %v (%s), want a definite entity_not_found (before restart: %v)", after, servicerpc.Classify(after), before)
		}
	}
	if reply, err := client.Info(s.ctx, target(t, founded.Alliance.AllianceID)); err != nil || reply.Alliance.AllianceID != founded.Alliance.AllianceID {
		t.Fatalf("info on the founded alliance after restart: %+v %v", reply.Alliance, err)
	}
	t.Logf("EMPTY-CLAIM alliance %d: before restart %v; after restart preload listed=%d loaded=%d empty=%d failed=%d, info answers entity_not_found",
		empty, before, report.Listed, report.Loaded, report.Empty, report.Failed)
}
